blocks.html:
Response for translation entities endpoint.
Returns paginated entities with only their translatable fields and all their translations.

types.name: data
types.description:
The list of entities with their translatable fields.
Each entity contains only the fields configured as translatable
for that entity type in the translation settings, plus all
translations for all locales.

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the entity being translated.

children.name: reference
children.description: The name of the table that the translation belongs to.

children.name: locale_code
children.description: The BCP 47 language tag code for this translation.

children.name: translations
children.description:
The translations of the resource.
The object's keys are the field names of the data model, and its value is the translated value.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date and time the translation was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date and time the translation was last updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date and time the translation was deleted.

types.name: offset
types.description: The offset of the current page.

types.name: limit
types.description: The limit of items per page.
